entities.summary: David Alroy or Alrui, also known as Ibn ar-Ruhi and David El-David, was a Jewish Messiah claimant born in Amadiya, Iraq under the name Menaḥem ben Solomon. David Alroy studied Torah and Talmud under Hasdai the Exilarch, and Ali, the head of the Nizamiyya of Baghdad. He was also well-versed in Muslim literature and known as a worker of magic.
